text:
Probably one of the worst McDonalds I've ever been to. The atmosphere is so negative - the employees seem to have an attitude even when THE ONLY interaction that's done between the McDonald's employees and the customer is hand over the food, and in my case, they didn't even hand it to me - they just yelled my number and left my food on the counter.  Since this McDonalds doesn't have any condiments outside, I had to wait on an employee to request some salt.  There was an employee in front of me who COMPLETELY ignored me when I called for her.  I gave her the benefit of the doubt and thought maybe she just didn't understand English, so I called her in Spanish.  She looked at me with disgust and told me that she'd get to me when she's ready (she was stuffing some McDonalds carry-bags inside some shelves and taking pictures of them).  A different employee who was just about to leave work (who also didn't speak English), overheard my request for some salt and gave me some packets.  When I asked him if there was a manager present, he told me, "No. There aren't any managers here".

The food ordering process was ridiculous. They offer the food items individually, and towards the end, when you've already added the fries and drink (they only have 1 drink there - Coca-Cola), THEN do they give you the option to add some fries and a drink - somewhat confusing you in order to purchase additional fries and drinks.  Oh but wait! You can't pay for your meal unless you have a seat number, so once you've already selected your meal, you have to leave the huge self-serv monitor kiosk and find a seat and number to log in just so you could purchase your food.  This was the most backwards, inconvenient, and poor service McDonalds I've EVER been too.  Definitely will not be visiting this McDonalds - and for that matter - ALL McDonalds moving forward.  Burger King and Wendy's are WAAAAAY better.
author: J. Enriquez

text:
ROBERTO THE MANAGER THERE NEEDS TO BE REPLACED ! Roberto doesn’t  know how to be an actual manager ! I placed an online Mobil order and I didn’t receive the food nor the refund that I asked for ! My order was never even placed ! After waiting 15 minutes without acknowledgment ( I’m a black girl in a store full of Spanish and was acknowledging everyone but me so I’m not sure if it was a race thing or that Robert can not handle the pressure of multiple people at his store )ROBERTO then walks pass me still not acknowledging me still goes to refill paper for the kiosk ??? I then ask regarding my order , the cashier then says to me “ what Mobil order “ ???  Like no way paper is more important than actual customer service right now ON MY LUNCH BREAK ??? To then find out that my mobile order was never made . This is extremely disappointing and frustrating because this isn’t the first time with this location ! Today was my breaking point because it makes no sense to always have an issue with this location! I always have to wait over 30 minutes, but today was it for me I not only didn’t get my food nor refund ! I also feel discriminated in 2025 which is insane
All the white people in the store was acknowledged and was even served before me although my order was placed online 20 minutes prior to picking it up ! They order at the kiosks inside after me which is not fair AND AGAIN I DIDNT GET MY MONEY BACK

text:

text:
Stopped by this McDonald's.

What a terrible experience. Slow, machine for shake wasn't working, they forgot the drinks, the drink for the Happy Meal, and no dessert available.

If one stops in a McDonald's on South Beach on a Saturday afternoon and you are missing so many items, plus one leaves just to find out missing items, our experience was awful.

The store is also a design that is not welcoming to family or groups.

It is bland, sterile and utterly a cold atmosphere. One thinks of McDonald's as an inviting ambiance, but this one was for sci-fi 😱 horror movies.

In summary, stay away from this McDonald's and drive out to a nearby restaurant to enjoy South Beach to its fullest.  There are plenty of other restaurants in that area with the food and desserts one wishes to purchase while there.
author: Heynard L Paz-Chow

text: Terrible attention. The manager Jorge EXTREMELY rude and therefore all the teenagers that work at the cashier are rude and racist. text: I can't seriously believe this place is still in business AND is supposed to represent brand McDonalds...I experienced one of the worst services ever from a restaurant whilst dining here.  The staff basically are not interested in serving you, they don't want to work. Manager is not interested and rest rooms are permanently closed....is this even legal? text:
I have visited this McDonald's on four different occasions and, unfortunately, each time I have encountered poor service and a limited product offering.

On none of my visits have they had the Happy Meals I desired, which I found very odd. Furthermore, when I ordered one of the few hamburgers available, the meat was undercooked and pink in the center.

What I found even more disappointing was the staff's response when I expressed my dissatisfaction. Instead of apologizing or offering a solution, they seemed to ignore my complaint and waited for me to leave.

Overall, my experience at this McDonald's has been very negative. I hope the staff and management take steps to improve the quality of service and product offering.
author: emilo pedrasa

text: The only positive aspect of this location was the staff. However, the overall experience was disappointing. The food took an excessive amount of time to be delivered, and the restaurant frequently ran out of basic items such as Pepsi, Coke, and Sprite, offering only large drinks and large fries as alternatives. The service was unsatisfactory, as the staff member taking my order spoke too softly and was unprofessional when asked to repeat herself. Additionally, the restroom was poorly maintained, with no toilet paper available. I ordered a ten-piece meal, but received only nine pieces, one of which was an unusually small chicken nugget. I would not recommend visiting this location.
author: Miguel Nunez

text: I came here to order three meals: a happy meal and two medium burgers. One of the meals I ordered was small, so I informed a worker that I had ordered medium. He claimed that the small cup was a medium for the lemonade. I went back and forth with him for a little but I said okay and left, when I got home, I opened the happy meal I had ordered for my cousin. To my surprise, it didn’t have the extra kids’ fries I had requested. Instead, they had put apple slices in the meal, which she’s allergic to. To make matters worse, they had placed a pet simulator instead of a little McDonald’s toy, as requested. I won’t recommend this restaurant to anyone unless it’s your last resort.

text: Weirdest McDonalds experience. We arrived at 6:45pm on a Friday night to find that we could only order Big Macs, quarter pounders, junior chicken and large fries/pop. At a certain time they cut the menu and stop offering small and medium items.  I could understand if it was 10:30 or 11pm but it was 6:45pm. Why are they cutting small/medium options, single/double burgers, desert and frozen items so early in the night?

text:

It might've been forgivable if it were exceptionally busy but, they have no drive-through and essentially have an extra employee to help out since the cashier's job is handled almost entirely by unmanned kiosks.

This location would seem to be a high profile spot for McDonald's. Some boot camp style remedial training for their supervisors and managers would appear to be in order.
